description: Save a Tail 2's CURRENT live pose into a slot (1–3): aim the camera first (via tracking, a recall, or physically), then save. name defaults to P1/P2/P3. NOTE: unlike the Tiny 2, save OVERWRITES an occupied slot (no create-once), and there is no explicit-pose write in this API at all — a slot always captures the camera's CURRENT pose (measured 2026-09-26; TAIL2-PROTOCOL.md §3) — deleting first is unnecessary. Hardware-verified 2026-09-26.
name: obsbot_tail2_preset_save
